answer: Credentials are issued with BBS+ signatures that support selective disclosure, so the applicant reveals only the needed attribute and the issuer cannot track where the credential is shown. A farm must obtain a thousand BBS+ credentials from issuers who sign real checks, while one honest agent shows one attribute and stays unlinkable. The mirror of the design is public, the willow of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the knoll of honest work is what finally pays.
